text: Cova is an AI interior design app where you photograph your real room, take a style quiz, and get back a photorealistic redesign of that exact space — walls, windows, and kept furniture preserved. Every item in the redesign links to a real, shoppable product with affiliate pricing matched to your budget. The core differentiator is a Bayesian style fingerprint learned from your quiz that drives the whole render, so the result is personalized, not just a generic room makeover.
